title: LIVE CLOUD COVER
source_name: NOAA GOES-East (GOES-19) ABI L2 Clear Sky Mask, CONUS 2 km (5-minute scans)
variable: BCM binary mask (0 = clear_or_probably_clear, 1 = cloudy_or_probably_cloudy) gated by DQF==0; % = observed cloudy fraction per canvas neighborhood
coverage: Basin rectangle lon -93..-73.5, lat 40.5..49.5 (all Great Lakes + land). No shoreline cut: full rectangle stays visible.
transparency: Clear sky (<1%) and missing data are fully transparent (alpha 0). Only cloudy pixels paint, dark-blue (thin) to dark-purple (overcast).
what: Observed cloud cover right now from the GOES-East weather satellite: the share of 2 km satellite pixels flagged cloudy around each point. Clear areas are transparent so the map underneath shows through. A direct satellite retrieval — not a weather-model estimate, so no analysis blocks.
why_extreme: Overcast (near 100%) compresses into violet/dark-purple; thin cloud owns most of the color resolution.
